To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the CDw18 neutrophil surface glycoprotein (Mo1, GP150,95) complex is required for the rapid adherence response of PMNs to a variety of agonist stimuli, but is not required for maximal adherence of PMNs to endothelium induced by thrombin and LTC4.

the CDw18 neutrophil surface glycoproteins mediate neutrophil adherence in vitro in response to chemotactic agonists and that the CDw 18 glycoprotein complex is not required for neutrophil adhesion to endothelium in response to thrombin and leukotrriene C4.
neutrophil adherence in vitro is inhibited by MoAb directed against CDw18, but the effect is not complete.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of human neutrophil (PMN) adherence to cultured endothelial cells (CE).
the mechanisms of neutrophil adherence and migration through endothelium,
the molecular mechanisms of neutrophil adherence and migration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neutrophil adherence is a complex process involving multiple receptors, and that the CDw18 receptors are not required for the adherence of PMNs to endothelial cells.
the Mo1/LFA- 1 family of glycoproteins is involved in the adhesion of neutrophils to endothelial cells in vitro.

the CDw18 family of glycoproteins are required for neutrophil-endothelial adherence, and that the CDw180 glycoproteins can be functionally dissociated into two subgroups: the CD11b/CD18 heterodimer and the other two heterodimer subtypes, CD11c/CD18 and CD11a/CD18.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the neutrophil adhesion molecule CDw18 is a complex that is composed of 3 subunits: CD11a, CD11b, and CD11c.
CDw18 is not the only receptor involved in neutrophil adhesion to endothelium.
CDw18-dependent neutrophil adhesion is not the sole mechanism for neutrophils adherence to endothelium.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are at least two mechanisms of neutrophil adhesion.
the CD18 glycoprotein complex is a key player in the adhesion of neutrophils to the endothelium.
neutrophil adherence can be inhibited by anti-CDw 18 antibodies.
